rounds.method_summary: Added token-packed QKV projection and fused CPU attention when alpha equals one. Full protected Dev passed all gates with raw CPU ratio 0.396085888, score 0.629011827, and maximum error 5.01e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Implemented token-packed QKV/Gram projection for large single-batch cases and fused triangular-panel norm reductions. Protected Dev passed all gates with CPU ratio 0.429144151 and maximum error 4.95e-6, worse than the verified best 0.400625566; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Implemented triangular contractions into one preallocated buffer followed by a single row-norm reduction. Full protected Dev passed all gates with CPU ratio 0.419490378, score 0.607090347, and maximum error 4.89e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Computed only lower Gram blocks for Cholesky norms, separately from packed QKV projections. Full protected Dev passed all gates with raw CPU ratio 0.425103749, score 0.601832663, and maximum error 5.01e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Implemented paired fused CPU attention that jointly retrieves Cholesky factors and projected values for short sequences. Full protected Dev passed all gates with raw CPU ratio 0.440107684, score 0.587779442, and maximum error 5.48e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Packed both logit sets for one softmax and reused its output directly for norm contractions. Full protected Dev passed all gates with CPU ratio 0.419284712, score 0.607282980, and maximum error 4.95e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Replaced concatenated weight packing with separate QKV matrix products into shared output buffers. Full protected Dev passed all gates with raw CPU ratio 0.659045630, score 0.382714351, and maximum error 4.77e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Both softmax distributions now write into one per-call coefficient buffer, removing concatenation and separate perturbed-logit storage. Full protected Dev passed all gates with CPU ratio 0.417307642, score 0.609134776, and maximum error 4.95e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Replaced panel norm contractions with a triangular-factor inverse and one triangular solve. Full protected Dev passed all gates with raw CPU ratio 0.494034932, score 0.537269258, and maximum error 4.65e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Implemented wide Cholesky row-block products that accumulate into one buffer before a single norm reduction. Full protected Dev passed all gates with raw CPU ratio 0.427424954, score 0.599658539, and maximum error 4.53e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Grouped long-sequence Cholesky contractions into batched dyadic blocks. Full protected Dev passed all gates with raw CPU ratio 0.467827406, score 0.561816162, and maximum error 4.53e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.

Fused the first Cholesky-panel norm contraction with projected-value retrieval. Full protected Dev passed all gates with CPU ratio 0.465868561, score 0.563650886, and maximum error 4.95e-6; the evaluated candidate remains in place.
